title: "Analysing US Births"
format: html
author: Alexa Titherington
execute: 
 echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
average_births <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(average_births, aes(
  x = date_of_month,
  y = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = month.name[12:1]),
  fill = average_births
)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "mako",
    name = "Mean births"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Births by Calendar Position",
    x = "Day of month",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    births_december_25 = births[month == 12 & date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[month == 12 & date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_day_average = mean(
      births[month == 12 & date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]
    ),
    pct_of_baseline =
      births_december_25 / surrounding_day_average * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line(color = "#3B528B", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "mako", name = "Weekday") +
  labs(
    title = "Christmas Day Births as a Percentage of Baseline",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Births on December 25 (% of baseline)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#21918C"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#3B528B"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#31688E")
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(
  births ~ year + month + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_resid = stats::residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100
  )

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  dplyr::filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(calendar_date = lubridate::make_date(2001, month, date_of_month)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_labels <- tibble::tibble(
  calendar_date = lubridate::make_date(
    2001,
    c(12, 12, 1, 7),
    c(24, 25, 1, 4)
  ),
  holiday = c("Christmas Eve", "Christmas Day", "New Year's Day", "Independence Day"),
  label_offset = c(-7, 8, 12, 8)
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(calendar_resid, by = "calendar_date") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_date = calendar_date + lubridate::days(label_offset),
    label_y = mean_pct_resid - 7
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  calendar_resid,
  ggplot2::aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#35B779", linetype = "dashed") +
  ggplot2::geom_line(color = "#3B528B", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = holiday_labels,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = calendar_date,
      xend = label_date,
      y = mean_pct_resid,
      yend = label_y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#31688E"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_label(
    data = holiday_labels,
    ggplot2::aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#1B1B3A",
    fill = "#C7E9E4",
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Daily Birth Residuals Across the Calendar",
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
